study type: pre-post study without a control group
exposure: multifaceted strategy to improve the appropriateness of the indications for cesarean delivery
appropriateness of indication for cesarean: fetal distress, cephalopelvic disproportion
cohort: Pregnant women delivering at 41 hospitals belonging to the Spanish National Health Service
finding: The multifaceted strategy was effective for increasing the appropriateness of the indications for cesarean delivery and reducing the cesarean deliveries avoided.
